POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, AUGUST 12, 2024
  333 W. BROADWAY SUITE 206
  SEA SPRAY GARDENS, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Kimberly Lewis, Member
Pat Chotiswatdi, Member  Julie Lie, Member
Doug Killion, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 2:20 p.m., acting chair Julie Lie called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54303  Recommendation to approve the Policy Subcommittee minutes from June 10,
  2024.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Bedy, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  24-54306  Recommendation to discuss the HSAC 2024-2025 Policy Recommendation
  presented to council members.

  • Stated on the record Chair Sarah Bedy and member Pam Chotiswatdi joined
  the meeting via zoom due to medical unforeseen medical issues.
  • HSB Bureau Manager Paul Duncan advised, the policy recommendation has
  been forwarded to the Council. We will provide more details soon regarding
  when the Council will present on this item. City staff are currently unsure
  about the specifics of the presentation or who will present it. The committee
  will be informed once staff have this information.

  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Bedy, to

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None

  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  24-54307  Recommendation to discuss the Clean Sweeps Public Work presentation,
  presented at the Homeless Services Advisory Committee Meeting on August 7,
  2024.

  • Members of the subcommittee had questions regarding Grants Pass V.
  Johnson and what changes should constituents expect to see for the city of
  Long Beach.
  • Subcommittee members raised concerns about the need to designate safe
  places for individuals impacted by cleaning directives and providing shelter
  alternatives.
  • HSB Bureau Manager Paul Duncan, stated that the city managers office
  would be releasing a memo on Grants Pass V. Johnson, the memo will be
  sent out to the committee.
  o Paul commented that the city cleaning process must adhere to the
  fourth and fifth amendments.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

4.  24-54308  Recommendation to discuss the Strategic planning process.

  • The new team under the city manager’s office is working on gathering input
  from individuals with experience or currently experiencing homelessness.
  Other efforts include the collaboration with the county to obtain data for a
  holistic understanding of homelessness.
  • The next public engagement meeting will be on August 27th from 4-6pm at

  Page 2 of 4
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, AUGUST 12, 2024
  333 W. BROADWAY SUITE 206
  SEA SPRAY GARDENS, 2:00 PM

  Michelle Obama Library.
  • The goal is to complete the strategic planning process by the end of the
  calendar year.
  • Members of the subcommittee expressed their interest in supporting with the
  strategic planning process. Staff will check in with the team to see what
  opportunities are available.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Killion, seconded by Member Lewis, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

5.  24-54309  Recommendation to receive and file the discussion regarding future agenda items.

  • Subcommittee members would like to discuss the Grants Pass v. Johnson
  case at the next meeting.
  • City staff will update the calendar meetings for the rest of the year to avoid
  any quorum issues.
  • Subcommittee members would like to discuss proactive measures to prevent
  the repetitive process of moving homeless individuals and propose to use
  vacant properties for tiny homes to address homelessness.
  • No public comment.

  A motion was made by Member Lewis, seconded by Member Killion, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Bedy, Chotiswatdi, Killion, Lewis, Lie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None
